title: Symmetry-Engineered Multiple Bulk-Boundary Correspondences and Anomalous Modes in a Non-Hermitian Creutz Ladder
summary: The synergy between non-Hermiticity and topology makes the bulk-boundary correspondence (BBC) highly elusive. Here we study a non-Hermitian Creutz ladder incorporating both gain-loss and nonreciprocity, and construct multiple BBCs involving scale-free, normal, and anomalous skin modes, as well as topological zero- energy modes. We characterize the skin effect induced by the parity-time (PT) phase transition through an average winding number, thereby formulating a PT-related BBC.
